Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global

Pokémon GO Fest
Starts:
Saturday, July 11, 2026, at 10:00 AM Local Time
Ends:
Sunday, July 12, 2026, at  7:00 PM Local Time

Join millions of Trainers across the globe for Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global! This worldwide event takes place from July 11, 2026 at 10 am to July 12, 2026 at 7 pm local time.

For the first time, GO Fest: Global is free for all Trainers who log in during event weekend. Everyone can access the featured Special Research, event bonuses, and increased Shiny encounter opportunities at no cost.

Bonuses

In-game bonuses for all Trainers

The following bonuses are active from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time on both event days.

Lure Modules activated during the event will last for one hour
Incense (excluding Daily Adventure Incense) will attract special Pokémon
Party Play will be active for nine hours
Increased chance of encountering Shiny Pokémon
Special Research including an encounter with Zeraora
Branching Timed Research with a choice between Mega Mewtwo X or Mega Mewtwo Y
Global Challenges to unlock additional bonuses and Ultra Unlock events
Different Pokémon type-themed Field Research every hour

The following bonuses are active from 12:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. local time on both event days.

Up to nine free Raid Passes per day by spinning Photo Discs at Gyms
Up to six Special Trades each day
1/2 Stardust cost for all trades
Open up to 50 Gifts each day

Features

Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y debut

Mewtwo’s Mega Evolutions, Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y, will make their Pokémon GO debut during GO Fest 2026: Global.

Mewtwo can now Mega Evolve into either Mega Mewtwo X or Mega Mewtwo Y, including Mewtwo you’ve already caught.

Starting during this event, Trainers can earn Mewtwo Mega Energy X and Mewtwo Mega Energy Y by defeating Mega Mewtwo X or Mega Mewtwo Y in Super Mega Raid Battles and by completing event Timed Research.

Defeat Mega Mewtwo X in Super Mega Raids to earn the energy needed to Mega Evolve Mewtwo into Mega Mewtwo X.

Defeat Mega Mewtwo Y in Super Mega Raids to earn the energy needed to Mega Evolve Mewtwo into Mega Mewtwo Y.

Every Mewtwo caught from Super Mega Battles during GO Fest: Global will have at least one Mega Level unlocked and can be Mega Evolved without the initial energy cost. If you’re lucky, it may be at Mega Level 2 or 3.

Mega Mewtwo requires more Mega Energy than typical Mega Evolutions, so planning raid paths and Timed Research rewards can help you unlock both forms faster.

Featured Attacks

All Mewtwo caught during in-person GO Fest events by ticket holders will know the Fast Attack Counter and the Charged Attack Psystrike.

During in-person GO Fest events, only ticket holders can catch Mewtwo with the featured attacks.

During GO Fest: Global

Mewtwo caught from Mega Mewtwo X Super Mega Raids will know the Fast Attack Counter.

Mewtwo caught from Mega Mewtwo Y Super Mega Raids will know the Charged Attack Psystrike.

Mega Evolution system updates

Additional Mega Evolution updates are planned around GO Fest timing:

  • Trainers will be able to spend extra Mega Energy to progress Mega Levels faster.
  • For species with multiple Mega Evolutions, Mega Level progression is tracked separately for each form (such as Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y).

Special Research: Zeraora

For the first time in Pokémon GO, Trainers can complete Special Research to encounter Zeraora, the Thunderclap Pokémon.

Trainers who log in during event weekend will receive this Special Research, and it does not expire.

Spawns

Featured wild encounter rotations

During each hour of the event, Pokémon associated with specific types will appear more frequently in the wild.

Saturday

  • 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. - Stormfire Peaks (Ice, Electric, Fire)
  • 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. - Astral Tides (Psychic, Ghost, Water)
  • 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. - Dragonflight Summit (Flying, Rock, Dragon)

Sunday

  • 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. - Earthforged Domain (Ground, Steel, Normal)
  • 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. - Verdant Anomaly (Poison, Bug, Grass)
  • 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. - Twilight Battlefield (Dark, Fairy, Fighting)

Research

Field Research

Field Research will refresh each hour. Complete type-themed tasks during each featured type hour.

Special Research

Trainers who log in during event weekend will receive Special Research that leads to an encounter with Zeraora.

Trainers who attended GO Fest 2026 in Tokyo, Chicago, or Copenhagen and already encountered Zeraora will receive Zeraora Candy instead.

Timed Research

A branching Timed Research experience will be available, with a choice between Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y.

Real-world GO Fest events

Want to celebrate earlier in person? Tickets are available for GO Fest events in:

  • Chicago, USA - June 5 to June 7, 2026
  • Copenhagen, Denmark - June 12 to June 14, 2026

View event details and ticket links on Pokémon GO’s official GO Fest page.
